target.statement: PaAno + PAI achieves VUS-PR of 0.58 on TSB-AD-U-Eva (vs 0.52 base), the paper's headline best result

compute.basis: Requires downloading TSB-AD-U-Eva (350 series), running PaAno encoder training/inference per series plus PAI scoring, and reproducing the 5-run average; per-series runtimes are seconds but 350 series x 5 runs plus setup and possible code gaps push it to hours.

blockers: PaAno (ICLR'26) base method must be obtained and integrated; PAI repo may not bundle it
fusion weights and preprocessing details partly in appendix; exact reproduction of 0.58 may need tuning
title: PAI: Preserving Amplitude Information in Representation-Based Time-Series Anomaly Detection
